privacy.title: Data protection
privacy.retention: Keep seat history and the activity log for
privacy.retentionHint: Every night, seat history that ended before this and older activity entries are deleted, and people who left before this are anonymised. Current seats are never deleted.

legal.disclaimer: We check this website carefully but cannot guarantee that all information is complete and up to date. Links to other websites are their owners’ responsibility.

site.metaTitle: Seatline: seating plans for Swiss companies
site.metaDescription: See who sits where, plan moves, keep IT in the loop and keep the history. Sign in with Microsoft 365 or by e-mail. Hosted in Switzerland. Free for 30 days.
site.ctaNote: No credit card. Sign in with Microsoft 365 or by e-mail.
site.videoLead: Why a seating plan shouldn’t need a sales call.
site.f1Body: Free, taken and reserved desks at a glance. Find anyone in seconds.
site.f2Body: Upload your architect’s DXF or PDF and get rooms and desks drawn for you.
site.f3Body: Move people by dragging them to a new desk. Every change can be undone.
site.f4Body: Prepare a team move, let it happen overnight on the day you pick and print a moving list for the movers.
site.f5Body: Who sat where and since when, kept as long as you decide.
site.f6Body: People and teams update every night from Microsoft 365 — or import them from Excel in a minute.
site.f7Body: Show room sizes and equipment, each team’s area, kitchens and exits. Find a free standing desk in one click.
site.f8Body: Change teams, roles and leaving dates for many people at once. Leavers free their desk on their last day.
site.f9Title: E-mails to IT and to people
site.f9Body: IT gets a clear e-mail when someone leaves, joins or moves. People are told about their new desk.
site.f10Body: Enter how many people each team expects. See months ahead when you’ll run out of desks.
site.a1: In Switzerland, in Microsoft Azure (Zurich). Payments go through Stripe.
site.a2: No. With Microsoft 365, people sign in with their work account and Seatline reads names and departments from your directory. Without it, people sign in with a link by e-mail and you add them by hand.
site.a3: Every active desk on your plans: CHF 2 per month each for the first 50, CHF 0.99 for every desk from the 51st. Blocked desks are free.
site.a4: An admin subscribes in a few clicks. If nobody does, the workspace becomes read-only. Nothing is deleted.
site.q5: Who gets told when something changes?
site.a5: Any addresses you choose, such as IT or facility. They get one short e-mail per change: who left or joined, who changed team, who moved where.
site.q6: Can we try it before signing up?
site.a6: Yes. “Try the demo” opens a sample office you can change freely, no account needed. Or start the free trial with your own floors.
site.q7: How do our people get into Seatline?
site.a7: With Microsoft 365 they come in automatically, every night. Without it, import an Excel or CSV list, or add people one by one.
site.q8: Do you sign a data processing agreement?
site.a8: Yes. Our data processing agreement (DPA / AVV) is part of the terms, applies to every workspace and is online. Admins can e-mail themselves a PDF copy with their company’s name in Settings.
site.f11Body: Print a sticker for every desk. Scan it to see who sits there.
site.heroLead: Who sits where, planned moves and every change kept. Made for Swiss offices, CHF 2 per desk, CHF 0.99 from the 51st.
